records.title: 10-K
records.text: Subscription revenue increased by $190.0 million compared to the prior year primarily due to the impact of new subscription agreements and cloud transition agreements entered into and provisioned since July 31, 2024 of $154.0 million, and the renewal or extension of subscription services at the fully ramped annual fees after the initial committed term of $28.2 million.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We have experienced seasonal variations in our license revenue and, to a lesser extent, in our subscription revenue as a result of increased customer orders in our fourth fiscal quarter, which is the quarter ending July 31.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Continued investment is critical as we seek to assist our customers in achieving their technology goals, maintain our competitive advantage, grow our revenue, expand internationally, and meet evolving customer demands.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Because we pay our services professionals the same amount throughout the year, our gross margins on our services revenue are usually lower in these quarters.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our net cash provided by (used in) operating activities is significantly impacted by the timing of invoicing and collections of accounts receivable, the timing and amount of annual bonus payments, as well as payroll, commissions, payroll taxes, and other tax payments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Revenue: For the six months ended July 31, 2025, revenue was $20.1 billion, an increase of nine percent year-over-year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in subscription and support revenues for the three and six months ended July 31, 2025 was primarily caused by volume-driven increases from new business, which includes new customers, upgrades, and additional subscriptions from existing customers.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Remaining Performance Obligation: Total remaining performance obligation, which represents all future revenue under contract yet to be recognized, as of July 31, 2025 was approximately $59.9 billion, an increase of 12 percent year-over-year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We have undertaken various restructuring initiatives to improve operating margins and continue advancing our ongoing commitment to profitable growth which included a reduction of our workforce and office space reductions within certain markets.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Income from Operations: For the six months ended July 31, 2025, income from operations was $4.3 billion as compared to $3.5 billion from a year ago.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales from the Retail segment accounted for approximately 85.4% of consolidated net sales for the six months ended July 31, 2025, compared to 88.5% for the comparable period in fiscal 2025.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Comparable store net sales increased as a result of higher store traffic, transactions, average unit retail and conversion rate, while units per transaction decreased.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total inventory at July 31, 2025, as compared to July 31, 2024, increased by $91.5 million, or 15.1%, to $696.2 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Selling, general and administrative expenses increased by $43.6 million, or 12.5%, in the second quarter of fiscal 2026, compared to the second quarter of fiscal 2025.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Income from operations was 11.6% of net sales, or $174.4 million, for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 compared to 10.7% of net sales, or $145.1 million, for the second quarter of fiscal 2025.
